mapper.insert: insert into ee_audit_record(user_id, audit_type, audit_status, id_card_front, id_card_back, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{auditType}, #{auditStatus}, #{idCardFront}, #{idCardBack}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select r.record_id, r.user_id, r.audit_type, r.audit_status, r.audit_by, r.audit_by_name, r.audit_remark, r.id_card_front, r.id_card_back, r.create_time, r.audit_time, u.user_name, u.real_name, u.phonenumber from ee_audit_record r left join sys_user u on r.user_id = u.user_id where r.record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.update: update ee_audit_record set audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_by_name = #{auditByName}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, audit_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId}
